description: Accessibility Insights for Windows：帮助开发者发现并修复 Windows 应用的无障碍问题 | Helps developers find and fix accessibility issues in Windows applications
notes_cn: 这是 Canary 预发布版（上游把最新构建标记为 pre-release），更新较快，可能引入回归问题
上游以 MSI 分发并安装到 Program Files；本清单只解包其文件，不注册安装信息，因此没有 UIAccess（无法在 UIAccess 模式下检查提权窗口），需要时请以管理员身份运行
配置保存在 %LOCALAPPDATA%\AccessibilityInsights（已链接持久化）
应用自带自动更新检查，若提示更新请忽略或改用 scoop update，避免它把 MSI 装到 Program Files 之外
界面依赖 WebView2（Windows 11 自带；Windows 10 需安装 Edge WebView2 Runtime）
notes: This is a Canary pre-release build (upstream marks its newest builds as pre-release); updates are frequent and may contain regressions

Upstream ships an MSI that installs into Program Files; this manifest only unpacks the files and does not register an installation, so there is no UIAccess (elevated windows cannot be inspected in UIAccess mode) — run as administrator when needed
Settings are stored in %LOCALAPPDATA%\AccessibilityInsights (linked to a persisted directory)
The app has its own update check; ignore it or use scoop update instead, otherwise it may install the MSI outside Scoop
The UI relies on WebView2 (built into Windows 11; Windows 10 needs Edge WebView2 Runtime)
